title: Tesla: power across a room
canned_note: CANNED (mock mode): the model outputs below (abstraction, terms, CPC proposals, claim-fit scores and quotes, Wildcard ideas) were hand-written in the format Nemotron 3 Super returns; NOT model output. The seed patents were found by a web search for site:patents.google.com on 2026-10-13 (not Tavily). The patent pages are real captured copies; quote checks, CPC validation, citation chains, ranking, legal-status flags and all sizing math run for real.

input.goal: Deliver useful power (10 W) across a living room, about 2 m, to a lamp.
failed: Bigger coils: the magnetic field near the transmitter exceeded the public exposure limit (v2 spec sheet: inside ~0.85 m)
input.idea: Two tuned coils (resonant inductive coupling) that power a lamp 2 m away

US8461719B2.quote: a source resonator having a Q-factor Q 1 and a characteristic size x 1
US8461719B2.why: High-Q resonators set the range: the lever that lets power cross a room at low field strength.

US7825543B2.quote: over a distance D larger than a characteristic size L 1 of said first resonator structure
US7825543B2.why: Claims transfer beyond the coil size via evanescent coupling: the core of the room-scale goal.

US8629578B2.quote: configured to transfer power during predefined intervals
US8629578B2.why: Duty-cycling lowers average exposure; peripherals, short range.

US7774069B2.quote: A system for transcutaneous energy transfer
US7774069B2.why: Medical implants live under strict tissue-exposure limits: their alignment tricks transfer.

US9002469B2.quote: first and second primary coils configured to simultaneously transmit transcutaneous energy
US9002469B2.why: Splits the power across coils, lowering the peak field near any one coil.

US649621A.quote: a receiving coil or conductor similarly connected to ground and to an elevated terminal
US649621A.why: Tesla's 1897 root: tuned transmitter/receiver coils, but through the earth, not a room.

US1119732A.quote: a resonant circuit having its outer conducting boundaries, which are charged to a high potential
US1119732A.why: Wardenclyffe-era resonator; high potential, not low field.

ideas.mechanism: passive tuned strings that ring in sympathy and pass the energy along
ideas.transfer: A sitar's sympathetic strings ring without being touched. Put 3 passive tuned coils (furniture, picture frames) between the transmitter and the lamp so each short hop stays efficient.

ideas.mechanism: induction hob coil under the pan
ideas.transfer: Induction hobs move kilowatts through a coil. Hide hob-style coils in the walls?

evidence.title: US3761667A Output power control of induction cooking inverter (1971)

test_results: Bench test: 10 W at 0.5 m worked; at 2 m the lamp stayed dark
Living-room mock-up: only 2 relay coils can be hidden (picture frame + side table)
